label: Default branch
when: the view is rendered at the repository's default branch, which a toss at main also is
gloss: this is the version everyone sees

label: Off the default branch
when: a toss, or a ?use= pin the page honored, renders the view at another branch or at a commit
gloss: this is not the version everyone sees; the sidebar's ref bar turns warning too, and offers the way back to the default branch

label: Sidebar mark
when: no text is selected, and the view is at the default branch
gloss: nothing to report about the view; the FAB is a way into its sidebar

label: Highlighter
when: text is selected anywhere on the page, or in the page a toss frames; outranks every other glyph, and a ring surrounds the FAB
gloss: the selection can become a note, and the FAB's tooltip quotes it
note: opens the FAB sidebar on its Note tab, with the passage quoted

label: Frisbee
when: the view is off the default branch, and no text is selected
gloss: the same as the warning tint, said by a shape so that it does not rest on colour alone

label: No token
when: this browser holds no GitHub token
gloss: private reads will fail, and the newer-commits check cannot run; a home-screen app on iOS keeps storage of its own, so a token saved in Safari is not the one it reads
note: a hold on the FAB opens its menu, whose Get token and Paste token rows fetch and save one

label: Newer commits
when: the view is pinned to a commit, a token is saved, and the branch the link names (else the branch of an open pull request holding the commit) has moved on
gloss: newer work exists on that branch, and the count is how many commits it is ahead
note: redraws the view at the branch's latest commit

label: Takeover
when: a takeover is open over the view, and no text is selected; outranks the frisbee, so the tint alone says off-branch while a takeover is open
gloss: the sidebar's subject is what the takeover shows, and its layer strip leads with the takeover
note: opens the FAB sidebar, aimed at the takeover

label: Latest
when: the view is pinned to a commit, a token is saved, and the check found the branch still at that commit; silent wherever no check ran
gloss: this commit is the newest on the branch the link names
note: opens the FAB sidebar on its ref bar

label: Frisbee, drawn
when: as the frisbee, which it would replace
gloss: the same meaning, in a mark drawn after the 🥏 emoji a toss link wears in chat; its colour is still open, since the theme's warning amber reads pale on a light page even at full strength, and today's glyph rests at 70 percent of it
